svg.text: Tipper Truck App — Conceptual Entity-Relationship Diagram (Peter Chen Notation)
Demonstrating different geometric shapes: Rectangles (Entities), Diamonds (Relationships), and Ovals (Attributes)

g.text: Academic Note on Peter Chen Notation vs Relational Schema:
1. Different Shapes: Entities are Rectangles, Relationships are Diamonds, Attributes are Ovals. Primary keys have underlined labels.
2. Associative Relationship: The price matrix (SAND_TRUCK_PRICES) is represented as an M:N relationship (Priced At) bearing the attribute [price_ghs].
3. Weak Entity: ORDER_STATUS_LOG is a weak entity (double rectangle) dependent on ORDERS via an identifying relationship (double diamond).
4. Cardinality Numbers: 1, M, N explicitly mark mapping constraints instead of Crow's feet.
